notes.title: Episode 6 patch notes
notes.notes:
Added a Character Journal - You can find the character journal in the menu. Look for 'Journal'. If you don't see any entries, just start the episode and they should fill up after like one second. Entries will be updated the more you interact with the character. Heart symbols on journal entries indicate main LI's (LI's that will have a unique solo ending should you choose to go with that route). Please remember that you can pursue all the LI's and change your decision to be a one woman man later on if you want to experience all the relationships for now. Your call.

 Added achievements - Achievements for this episode have been added and should automatically sync with your Steam account. Note that there are achievements from older episodes that will come with the next episode. I didn't activate all of them because I thought having so many pop ups would get annoying. The variables are tracked and saved in your game so you will get them when I activate them even though they're older ones.

 The dialogue system - I didn't talk about this one when I implemented it in the previous episode but basically, sometimes, you'll get options to respond in a certain way - Friendly, Funny, Flirty, Aggressive. These responses will be linked to achievements/bonus image unlocks/bonus action and dialogue unlocks. For example : If you're always aggressive, you might be able to perform aggressive actions in some scenes based on how high your aggression points are.

 General notes - As you all know, I moved to another country and it took me a while to find a place, settle down and start working, which is what caused this gap between the previous episode and this one. I apologize for the delay and assure you that releases will be much faster now that I'm all settled in. The next episode is planned in the first few week or two of January and may even be out if I finish before that.

I realize that the slow burn might be getting too slow for some of you. All I can say is that the next episode will change that. I've already written down most of the scenes for the next one so I just have to start working on renders now. If you have any questions or if you find any bugs, feel free to join my discord channel. Click on the logo at the main menu and come say hi.

Thank you all for giving my game a shot!

- CC

notes.title: Random update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

After my last post here, I had some exams I had to attempt and had almost decided to drop them because they came out of nowhere and I wasn't prepared. However, I ended up 'trying' to clear tem instead of dropping them. I probably wont get through this time but I just wanted to give it a shot since I had already paid for them. I've been back home for the past 4 days now and I resumed renders as soon as I got back. I'll have to speed it up a little this month because I want to release by the end of the month or at least the first week of next month. 

Working on these renders has really been fun for me because I can finally start introducing important characters. I had created a bunch of them maybe 3 months ago but they weren't ready to show up in the story yet. I was trying to be ambitious with two free-roam events this time but I'm probably going to have to stick to one event. They won't be confusing free-roams and will be very straight forward just like my other ones. It looks like this update will have at least 10 scenes if not more so it's taking me a while to create these scenes before I throw the characters in. I want there to be at least some variety since a lot of VN's use the same assets so I try to change colors / textures, add / remove props so there's a slightly more unique feel to the scenes. Most players won't even notice things like this but it's just something I think is important since there are 1000's of VNs out there.

tldr : If all goes well, I'll have the update out by the end of this month. If there are hiccups, Early May.

notes.title: "When is the next update?"
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I hope you've all been doing great. I'm sorry I didn't pop in with updates for a while now. I've had a very busy month with family events and an engagement which were all in different states so I've been travelling a lot. My work flow took a hit and it took me a while to get it up and running again. 

It's been a while since the last update so I hope by now every one has managed to play the missing scene from before(Talitha's visit). I made a post about it as soon as I patched it in but I'm not sure if everyone read the post so I hope you didn't miss out.

I'll give you an exact release date as soon as I know what I can commit to. It'll definitely be out in the month of October but I would think there's a higher chance of it being in the second half of the month. My travelling aside, I had some issues with my writing for a while and I just didn't enjoy the content I wrote so I scrapped a LOT of it and started over. One thing I definitely don't want to do is release content I'm not happy with myself. If I don't like it, I can't expect anyone else to like it.

Just a reminder that the upcoming episode will be split in two parts. So the next two releases will count as ONE episode.
If you have any questions, you can always dm me on discord.
I hope you have a great rest of the week!

-CC

notes.title: ETA update + Random dev notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I hope you're all having a good weekend! I'm waiting on some renders as I type this so I thought I'd leave a random update for those who are interested in knowing.
I'm keeping around 3 more days to work on renders, followed by a few days to work on code, and then some bug testing. I'm liking how the episode is turning out so far and I hope you like it too. 

The update should be done on time with no problems. I really want to have a sale when the next episode is out so those who have the game on their wishlist have a chance of getting it at a discounted price. The next sale I can have is on the 8th of August so it looks like that should be our release date. Random reminder - updates are free.

I read every review the game gets because I want to know what you like/ don't like about the story so far. There are so many positive reviews and I'm very grateful to have all of you try the game in such an early stage. I've seen a few posts about the length of the game being short right now and I hear you. This is fairly early access and It's nice to know that you still enjoyed the game. I'll try my best to dish out updates as fast as I can and development time will improve as soon as I can upgrade to a PC. I'm going to be investing in a 3090 or 3080ti (for those who are curios) which is a massive upgrade from my current 2060 laptop.

If you have any questions / suggestions, as always, my discord pms are always open. A few of you already contacted me so feel free.

-CC

notes.title: ETA of the next update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
First of all, thank you all for buying the game. Just looking at the number of users put a huge smile on my face that I wasn't able to shake off for a while. 

My original plan was to release a new episode WITH the launch but my trusty laptop wasn't so trusty anymore and so that took around 2 weeks to fix. Needless to say, I had to recuperate from a loss of data before starting to work on the next episode.

Things are back on track now and the new episode ETA is somewhere around this month. More towards the end if I'm being realistic since I have to go through a few rounds of bug testing and I also plan on making a few quality of life changes. These will not affect the plot in any way. If any of you have suggestions, please feel free to join my discord server and either pm me there or just post it in chat and I'll get back to you as soon as I can. Again, this update and any future updates for at least a year if not more are completely FREE. 

Progress wise, I'd say I'm more than 60% done (script, renders, code, music). My pms on discord are always open if you have more detailed questions.

Once again, thanks! 

-CC
